basis: The August 8 actuals qualify. Diodes reported consolidated net sales of $467,152,000 for Q2 2023 versus $500,972,000 for Q2 2022. The 95% cutoff was $475,923,400. The May 9 forecast reached $481,010,000 at its high end, exceeding the cutoff by $5,086,600. The earliest date remains unresolved because the June 1 TD Cowen and June 6 Baird management remarks could not be verified from an issuer or event-host recording, transcript or session-specific deck. The upper_bound below is the verified August 8 actual.

coverage.detail: Preceding earnings cycle, February 6. Diodes assigned its $467 million ±3% revenue forecast explicitly to Q1 2023.
The issuer-furnished February 6 call transcript likewise gives Q1 guidance. No numeric Q2 consolidated revenue ceiling was identified.
The April 18 notice scheduled the May 9 earnings release and call. It supplied no Q2 sales estimate.
The May 9 Q1 release forecast Q2 revenue of $467 million ±3%. Flat sequential revenue described the midpoint. The stated range extended to $467,000,000 × 1.03 = $481,010,000.
Slide 15 of the May earnings presentation repeats the Q2 range and dates the guidance May 9.
Slide 32 of the full investor presentation also gives $467 million ±3% as of May 9. Its date limits what the deck establishes about the June sessions.
On the May 9 public earnings call, the CFO repeated $467 million ±3% for Q2. Diodes furnished the transcript May 16.

Diodes announced May 31 Mizuho participation and two fireside chats, June 1 at TD Cowen and June 6 at Baird. It specifically promised a live webcast and archived replay for TD Cowen. The announcement contains no revenue update.
The indexed issuer page identifies May 31 and says the webcast was unavailable. A direct fetch failed. The issuer announcement describes meetings with registered attendees.
Attempted 2023 issuer event URL returned a cache miss. The similarly named issuer page ending in -0 is for May 30, 2024.
The Wayback request for the candidate issuer page was inaccessible. I could not inspect a historical replay link.
Cowen’s conference calendar confirms its 51st annual Technology, Media & Telecom Conference on May 31–June 1. It provides no Diodes session remarks.

Another presenter’s official webcast link identified cowen138 as the event code. Neither https://wsw.com/webcast/cowen138/ nor this candidate Diodes path yielded a readable session. The Diodes path remains unverified. The archive lookup at https://archive.org/wayback/available?url=wsw.com%2Fwebcast%2Fcowen138%2Fdiod%2F&timestamp=20230601 was also inaccessible.

A third-party transcript listing identifies the Diodes Cowen session at 18:00 GMT on June 1, matching the announced 2 p.m. EDT chat. The transcript fetch failed, including at https://www.gurufocus.com/stock/DIOD/transcripts/2193710. The listing establishes no revenue figure.
Diodes’ readable event page confirms June 6 at 2 p.m. EDT, says “Webcast not available” and supplies no session deck or transcript.
Baird’s conference recap confirms the June 6–8 public-company track. It provides no Diodes session transcript or Q2 sales figure.

Other presenters’ published links identify baird68 as the webcast event code. The event root https://wsw.com/webcast/baird68/ and this candidate Diodes path were inaccessible. No Diodes recording was verified.
The May 24 8-K reports shareholder voting under Item 5.07. It supplies no conference exhibit.
The June 2 8-K concerns the amended credit agreement signed May 26. It supplies no June conference presentation or Q2 revenue update.
The July 18 release scheduled the August 8 results announcement. It gave no preliminary sales figure.

The August 8 release’s consolidated statements of operations give net sales in thousands of 467,152 and 500,972 in the respective 2023 and 2022 three-month columns. These directly comparable reported figures establish the decline.

publication_date_evidence: The results release carries an August 8, 2023 Plano dateline and announces that day’s results for the quarter ended June 30. This verifies when Diodes published the actuals. The unresolved June conference remarks prevent certification of the earliest qualifying public date.
